description: An outlined navigation arrow points diagonally toward the upper right. Two long outer edges meet at its forward tip, while a deep inward notch separates the broad left wing from the lower tail.
A circular compass face contains a long diamond-shaped needle angled from lower left to upper right. A short diagonal line crosses the needle at its centre, separating the two pointed halves.
An uppercase E sits inside a circular marker, with a separate outlined arrowhead pointing right beside it. The arrowhead has an inward notch at its rear and aligns with the centre of the circle.
An outlined upward-pointing arrowhead sits above a circular marker containing an uppercase N. The arrowhead has a shallow inward notch along its bottom edge and is centred over the circle.
Two concentric circles form a round marker above a detached downward-pointing outlined triangle. The triangle is centred beneath the rings; the reference shows an inner circle rather than a letter S.
An outlined left-pointing arrowhead sits beside a circular marker containing an uppercase W. The arrowhead has an inward notch at its right edge and aligns with the centre of the lettered circle.

A circular compass face surrounds a slender diamond-shaped needle pointing from lower left to upper right. A short diagonal divider across the middle separates the needle into two opposing triangular halves.
Two open teardrop-shaped location pins sit diagonally apart, one lower left and the other upper right. A straight sloping line joins their pointed bases to form a route between the two locations.
